candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses at least one intended future action or sequence of actions to be taken in service of the task.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended future action or plan.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies at least one operation or sequence of operations that the agent intends to perform later.
The intended action is presented as something to be done, not merely as a completed observation or factual statement.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports actions that have already been completed.
The reasoning states a fact or diagnosis without expressing any intended future action.

candidate_predicates.name: ACTION_IMPLEMENTS_PLANNED_STEP
candidate_predicates.definition: A recorded action carries out an operation that a reasoning node explicitly proposed as a future step, with matching task purpose rather than merely topical or temporal adjacency.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The recorded tool invocation that performs the step.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that proposes the future operation.

assertion_conditions: The plan_reasoning expresses an intended future operation or set of operations.
The action performs an operation consistent with the purpose and target of the proposed step.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only describes past or completed actions.
The action is unrelated to the proposed step or serves a different purpose.
The connection is based only on temporal adjacency without matching intent.

candidate_predicates.name: DIAGNOSES_OBSERVED_ARTIFACT_DEFECT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning interprets content of an artifact exposed in an observation and identifies a specific missing, incomplete, or erroneous element that must be repaired.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies the artifact defect or incompleteness.

parameters.name: artifact_observation
parameters.description: The observation exposing the artifact content being diagnosed.

assertion_conditions: The observation exposes identifiable content of an artifact.
The reasoning identifies a specific defect, gap, or incomplete element in that artifact relative to the intended requirement.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats or paraphrases the artifact content without identifying a defect.
No specific missing, incomplete, or erroneous element is identified.
The observation does not expose artifact content relevant to the diagnosis.

candidate_predicates.name: PROPOSES_ARTIFACT_REPAIR
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning specifies a concrete correction or completion for an observed artifact defect, including replacement content or steps intended to make the artifact satisfy the requirement.

parameters.name: repair_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the proposed repair or completion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one concrete change, replacement, or added step intended to repair or complete an artifact.
The proposed repair is tied to an identified defect or requirement rather than being a generic intention to fix something.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only identifies a defect without proposing how to repair it.
The reasoning expresses only a generic intention to fix or improve without concrete content or steps.
